name: @taste-and-see/sentry
description: Sentry error reporting for Taste & See (CLAUDE.md §10). Errors only — @taste-and-see/tracing owns spans and metrics, so the Node SDK is initialised with skipOpenTelemetrySetup and no instrumentation integrations. The `.` subpath is SDK-free (pure scrubbing + option types) so the Next.js portals can share the redaction rules without pulling in @sentry/node; `./node` carries the @sentry/node bootstrap. Redaction key names are DERIVED from @taste-and-see/logger's DEFAULT_REDACT_PATHS so there is exactly one PII list on the platform.
